title: Chapter 737
paragraphs: Chapter 737
Episode 184. Beyond Destiny (9)
Basement level 2.
As soon as the group of five, including Jin, descended, they felt the air becoming stifling.
The second basement level was filled with an aura and energy that was significantly amplified to interfere with the formation of magic power.
"It's... worse... than what... Alphen... said before."
Bianca said, forming and releasing aura on her greatsword repeatedly. The aura tied to the greatsword was only at 70% of its usual level.
The rest of the party was in a similar situation.
This was true for Alphen as well, who was unaffected until the chain was cut.
"It feels like my senses have also dulled a bit."
"It's not just a feeling, it has actually dulled, Ghost Captain. Though it's minuscule."
At Hedo's answer, Octavia sighed internally.
Not only being separated from the allied forces, but having problems with individual combat power was inevitably burdensome.
[It's definitely worse than I perceived.]
"Maybe the reason why the aura interference has worsened is because Alphen has been freed from the control of the chaos monster."
[The energy used to control me has decreased, freeing up more, so they enhanced the aura interference?]
"Yes."
[It's a reasonable story.]
Although the group had no way to verify this themselves, Jin's speculation was accurate.
However, if there was one oversight, it was Tasha's existence.
Not only Alphen, but Tasha had also been freed from the control on the allied side, so it was natural that the interference was so severe.
Whatever happened, they had no choice but to move forward. Jin reminded the group of this fact again.
Once again, it was an endlessly black and vast space.
The group moved silently for a while as if they were in a desert.
Something began to appear when the group stopped counting their steps.
In the distance, a figure that looked like a person was beginning to show.
'This time, are there five....?'
As the distance got closer, the exact number of heads became clear.
The party momentarily felt a sense of discomfort at the fact that the number of people was coincidentally the same.
[Come on.]
The knight standing in the middle opened his mouth.
Looking at the twin swords on the knight's waist, Jin immediately recognized him.
"'The 16th family head, Léon Runcandel. The greatsword must be the 29th family head, Tuker Runcandel, and the chain sword is the 35th family head, Nep Runcandel.'"
On the other hand, the remaining two carrying ordinary long swords were unrecognizable.
If their faces were exposed, they could have been identified by comparing with past portraits and memories, but their faces were hidden by the chains.
In other words, Jin had only two people to respect among them.
"I am an unworthy descendant meeting two of my ancestors. Please bear with it a little longer. I will soon break your bindings."
[Do you think you can save these two people here, like the 20th standing over there?]
"That's the intention, Léon."
Thunk-!
Suddenly, Léon's sword severed the left arm of the family head next to him.
The head of the family was chained. The family head, whose arm had fallen with a thud, had no reaction like a doll.
Jin narrowed his brows and glared at Léon.

[The family head is absolute. It's a law that hasn't changed since the day the family started. Those who break that law, like you, are not needed in the family. No matter how excellent, they only muddy the water. You are damaging the authority of the current family head, Rosa Runcandel. Stop it now.]
Ching!
A flash of light flew into Léon's chest. It was a sword energy shot by Alphen.
Leon knocked off the sword energy with his hand and looked at Alphen.

[In my childhood, I listened to the martial arts tales of my great-grandfather from the long-standing vassals of the family and my heart pounded. Today, it seems all a lie.... Authority? What authority is there for the monster that has brought the family to this state!]

[20th, you were called the Knight of Light and led an unprecedented great war to victory. If you had followed the will of the family head while preserving that achievement, it would have been very pleasing.]
[Shut up, I must take the value of my memories being sullied today. Those without chains will all perish.]
Jin confirmed that Leon did not attack the family head whose arm he had severed further.
'He left the sword-wielding right arm. He cut off the left arm just to provoke us, he doesn't intend to kill the family head and seriously lose power.'
That meant they could save both family heads chained up.
Five against five.
It was natural to take one opponent each.
Jin had chosen his opponent from the moment Leon severed the left arm of the family head next to him.
'I will confront the family head whose arm has not been severed and rescue him in the most intact state possible, while Sir Alphen takes on Léon.'
While Jin was thinking, Bianca kept her gaze on Tuker's greatsword.
"Jin... I... want... to confront... that... greatsword...."
"Do that, and Sir Hedo, please confront the 35th family head with the chain sword. Octavia, you take care of the ancestor who lost his left arm."
Jin thought that Octavia was currently the weakest among the five.
She might be different if she had the Ghost Squad or was enhanced by the magic stone, but as it stood, she had to take the weakest opponent.
"But, never kill the ancestor. Once the chain is broken, he will be an ally."
"Try hard."
"It's not about trying, you must do it."
If not, I will kill you.
Jin did not say the last part out loud, but Octavia clenched her teeth as she momentarily felt a chill down her spine.
The situation was sorted out.
Long conversations were unnecessary. No one would be harmed by accident, it was just a fight until one side was defeated.
The start of the battle was signaled by Jin's 3rd Lunecandle dueling technique, Meteor Rain. The bright sword energy was falling, tearing through the dim sky.
The former heads of the family scattered left and right to avoid the Meteor Rain.
Whenever Meteor Rain's sword energy struck the ground, earthquakes occurred and heavy shock waves spread out.
Even before Meteor Rain reached its midpoint, the spectacle of the family's dueling techniques running rampant in various places continued.
Given that there were seven, including Jin, who were the heads of Lunecandle, this was an expected sight.
If this place were an ordinary castle.
Most of the buildings would have been destroyed without a trace before a minute passed since the start of the battle.
From a distance, their battles seemed like natural disasters at each turn.
The former heads of the family seemed to have the upper hand in terms of power.
It was inevitable since Jin's group was limited in generating energy.
The former heads of the family were using not only their aura but also their soul energy freely.
A dark storm ceaselessly engulfed the fighting individuals.
Only Jin's group was hit by this soul energy. In order to fully focus their respective opponents on themselves, they couldn't avoid the soul energy properly.
The group was exerting their full power without a scouting battle.
They had to swiftly defeat their respective opponents and support the others to control the battle situation.
'12th might have made me fight Iza because he lost his left arm and his power would surely decrease, but it seems he was mistaken.'
Octavia thought this while withstanding the former head's sword.
Being right-handed but unable to use both hands is certainly a critical restriction.
However, Octavia's opponent was using a fiercer and more flawless sword than the other heads.
The difference was so clear that it was noticeable even to Octavia, a magician.
Soon Octavia was able to realize the reason.

'...Iza is not fighting with his skills now. The manipulator, the evil god's swordsmanship must have reached such a level. It's not a problem even if one arm is missing. I don't know if such a thing is possible.'
A chillingly sharp blow penetrated her body every moment.
Perhaps because her inner realm had deepened, Rosa was controlling the former head even more delicately than when fighting Alphen.
Jin also recognized this fact.
He too was realizing this while mixing his sword with his opponent's.

'I should have made Hedo face that side instead of Octavia. If it continues like this, it's only a matter of time before Octavia is defeated. I have no choice but to defeat my ancestor as quickly as possible and help.'
The moment Jin thought that far, he heard Hedo's voice.
"Jin! Don't worry about the Ghost Captain, I'll back you up!"
"I will... try... my best... to help... too!"
Fortunately, there was a gap between Heddo and the 35th generation, as well as between Bianca and the 29th generation.
Alpen and Leon were on thin ice, too challenging for even Jin to estimate.
Soon, Jin focused his gaze on his opponent.
Under the chains of the monster, he seemed to see the shining eyes of Runcandel, who had not finally given in.

"Monster, what is the reason you continue to disgrace our ancestors like this? Even if you tie them with chains and forcibly control them, in the end, they will all point their swords at you again, like Alpen. You can steal bodies but you cannot corrupt souls."
Slash!
Blood burst simultaneously from the back of Jin's hand and his opponent's. The swords that had stabbed each other scraped by.
Both people rotated their bodies to the right and fired sword energy.
"So you want to have the real Runcandel by corrupting their bodies if not their souls?"
Swoosh...!
A weak magic swirled around Bradamante, sparking blue flames.
Eternal flame, a fire that cannot be extinguished by anything.

"Your Runcandel is not legitimate. That's why you cannot control them without chaining them. From my perspective, the chains you use to control our ancestors are a manifestation of such deficiency and self-loathing. You pretend to be a god, but in fact, you are still a frail and disgusting human."
Taking the family by dirty power, oppressing people with fear, building a huge castle, showing off power as if ready to destroy the world at any time.
No matter how much you try to hide your true nature...
Essence cannot be hidden.
Every time Jin continued to speak, there were openings in the opponent's swordsmanship.
The swordsmanship that could be perfect even with one arm was gradually crumbling.
On the contrary, Jin's sword was carrying a deeper and more transparent fire.
Inch by inch, the eternal flame was getting closer to the chain.
With a flawed sword, it's impossible to stop the fire from getting closer. It can only delay the sword touching the chain by enduring and enduring.
Jin and his opponent's offensive and defensive fight continued until the roaring sound that filled the battlefield subsided.
Jin, absorbed in his fight, didn't even know how much time had passed.
But what he could definitely know was that Bradamante, finally dyed in the eternal flame, touched the chain that wrapped around the opponent.
Clang...!
With the sound of the chain breaking, Jin looked into the opponent's eyes.
He thought he had to greet the ancestor who had barely regained his physical body.
But the face revealed by the broken chain was not the old head of Runcandel.
The monstrous Rosa.
What the chain had been covering was her, in human form.
